case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the labour cost situation so openly. We value the long-standing cooperation with your foundry and the quality of your work.

The offer as submitted is not a level we can accept. We have therefore put together three options. Options A and B also offer you faster payment than your current terms would give you in the other direction, so please see which fits your situation best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

We hope one of these works for you and are glad to talk it through.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract term, which provides valuable stability for both our companies.
Building on your Option C, we can accept the extended term with 30 days payment, but the price must remain sustainable for our foundry.
We are prepared to offer €51.30 per unit under these terms, representing a significant step towards your position.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your reply and for moving towards us on the contract term. We appreciate your openness and the stability a longer agreement brings to both sides.

The price you propose is still not where we can close, so we have set out our options once more. Option C keeps your preferred payment terms. Options A and B give you faster payment than the terms you have today.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 47.36; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.98; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.05; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Please let us know which option suits the foundry best. We are glad to talk it through by phone.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the continued commitment to our 24-month agreement. 

For generations, our family foundry has built its reputation on pride, quality craftsmanship, and long-standing regional partnerships like the one we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Building on your Option C, we can reduce our price to €50.70 per unit. This is a fair step that reflects our long-standing partnership, and we would be glad to discuss this further in a call as you suggested.

Under our proposal, our Angebot stands at a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to speaking with you soon and continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
